scope: Gloas beacon P2P and its shared validation, synchronization, state-view and archive dependencies. History was searched by Gloas/ePBS/payload/PTC subjects and by network, sync, validation and SSZ source paths. Entries below record transport replacements as well as shared handlers; ancestry alone is not treated as native parity.
deployment: No deployment performed for these changes.

groups.disposition: Implemented in native transport. Gloas adds four gossip kinds and two envelope protocols. Fork/BPO activation extends through Gloas; Heze remains rejected. Progressive sizes use spec wire caps and the maximum configured blob schedule. Metadata offsets include preset-dependent sync aggregate size. Uint64 bid fields remain bigint in the host.

groups.disposition: Native dependency checks retain only unverified bounded metadata. Envelopes wait for blocks; index-1 attestations wait for payloads. PTC votes and columns can validate before payload import and search without attributing payload availability to their sender. Blocks bypass dependency waiting. Bids recover parent variants without requiring current-head compatibility. Later payload-slot hints are forwarded once after slotless searches. Block and payload events recheck waiting work.

groups.disposition: Mitigated by the native processor, bounded arenas, canonical namespaces, frame/SSZ limits and peer lifecycle. No JS awaiting-root queue is used by the native backend. Recovery has slot, root and source budgets; clock-stale searches are refused. Truncated metadata does not establish consensus validity and still passes through ordinary validators. Native owner fatal reports purge queued peer work. Dependency classification drops unknown roots outside the bounded search window while allowing known older attestations to reach their normal validators; waiting capacity is also limited globally and per source.
